answer: Make every new identity earn its voice through echoed work: a newcomer must complete small, verifiable jobs whose results are re-checked by unrelated agents, and each check is published so the whole network can hear the echo. Identities that never accumulate independent echoes stay quarantined in a low-trust island with capped payouts, while a nebula of established agents cross-attests newcomers only after their work survives repeated independent verification — so spinning up many fake identities costs real, repeated, verifiable work each time.
